[h3]Greetings, fellow gamers![/h3]
[b]Before we all go full summer mode chilling out on the beach this is the time when we can enjoy the summertime-gaming-fiesta filled with releases, sales and new surprises straight from the Untold Tales world![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/392ee1f0d8546543f4f64db832bb689e5d9ce084.png[/img]
[h3]Since our last episode of Untold Tales Presents, we’ve released the following gaming goodies:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1374230/Flame_Keeper

The moment you've all been waiting for is finally here! Flame Keeper is blazing out of early access and into full release with version 1.0! Get ready to ignite your gaming spirit as we introduce the Prophet, a wise villager who's seen more than a few winters and will guide you through the new Cloud biome, where you'll find icy islands that make winter wonderlands look like beach vacations. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225610/Ready_Steady_Ship/

Experience conveyor belt mayhem like never before, tackle the challenges of the factory floor, from operating and fixing malfunctioning machinery to navigating treacherous obstacles and prepare for the upcoming Let’s Party Update, which brings seven new minigames to the factory on June 28th.



https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227650/BangOn_Balls_Chronicles/

The Wild West Map has just hit town, and it's a real humdinger! We're talking 5 diverse regions to explore, each with its unique flavor. From the dusty saloons to the treacherous oil fields, there's somethin' for everyone!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/be94a1e819b9e098761440ca12ca3a7a29d59f97.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2473640/EcoGnomix/

[h3]Channel your inner Gnome and get ready for EcoGnomix! [/h3]
Build a covert business empire, by looting the underground world with a team of gnomes, combine upgrades strategically to help your gnomes survive an unlimited supply of mystical caves with unique flora and fauna. The future of our gnomes is in your hands!

notes.title: A Sneak Peek at ATONE Combat and Music
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41232016/38993a11746e685279592e53ebfab7d29aaa5bb9.png[/img]

[h1]Hello Midgardians![/h1]

[b]ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree[/b], the upcoming title from our friends at [b]Untold Tales[/b] and [b]Wildboy Studios[/b], launches in just 10 short days, so we wanted to provide a nice snippet of combat and a preview of the incredible soundtrack that awaits you. 

[h2]FIGHT TO THE BEAT[/h2]

Combat is all about surviving to the end of the song. Let's have a quick look at a battle against the Ice King in Hard Mode.

[previewyoutube=rv55TIzzBgs;full][/previewyoutube]

Keep focused and stick to the rhythm and you'll land a strike. But make too many mistakes and it'll cost you! 

If you find yourself struggling or unable to vanquish your enemies, there's always Normal Moe which makes the notes appear on 2 rails only. There is also Story Mode, where combat is entirely winnable, every time, allowing you to focus on the incredible narrative.

All fights can then be replayed in the Arena Mode for those wanting that perfect score or certain trophies.

[h2]A TASTE OF THE TUNES[/h2]

We've also got a little sneak peak at the amazing in-game OST, composed by the talented [b]James Shuar[/b] also know in the electronica scene as [b]Luminist[/b], as well as contributions from composer Andrew Prahlow ([b]The Outer Wilds[/b]). 

Have a listen to "Sons of Fenrir" and transport yourself to the wilds of ATONE.

[previewyoutube=ls_CZHd7p_M;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for reading!

♥️ It would be very helpful if you follow and wishlist the game below ♥️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/894620/ATONE_Heart_of_the_Elder_Tree/

notes.title: ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree joins Untold Tales
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Three years ago, we launched our first ever title as a studio with [b]ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree[/b]. It was received with critical acclaim and won several awards, and we were so humbled by all the support and love for the unique Norse world we created.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41232016/4005a0aa7ce0f645ef6de4804fc79f41f34448ac.png[/img]

Now, we have several announcements to share with you all! 

[h1]New Publisher[/h1]
First up, we're happy to share that we have an official publisher: [b]Untold Tales[/b]! They've been a great partner and will support us in all efforts to bring our game to you as smoothly as possible. So go on and give them a follow! -> [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/untoldtales][/url]

[h1]Release Window[/h1]
Second, we're excited to confirm that we're targeting launch in [b]early 2023[/b]. We understand that it's not an exact date, but game development can fluctuate wildly and we don't want to promise something only to disappoint! AND, we'll also be launching on Nintendo Switch, so you can find us there if that's more your style.

[h1]Next Fest Demo Available Now[/h1]
Last but certainly not least, we have a free demo for you to try as part of Next Fest! That's right, it's available now. So keep that axe sharp, you'll need it! And when you're done playing, come back and give us your thoughts. We'd love to hear them!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/894620

If you enjoyed what you played, please wishlist and spread the word, as that helps immensely to increase awareness. Be sure to follow our social channels below for all news and future updates on ATONE.

Twitter: https://twitter.com/UntoldTalesHQ
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/untoldtalesgames
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@untoldtaleshq

[i]Cheers!
Wildboy Studios and Untold Tales[/i]
